title: ze_negative_legacy
description:
Only Stage 1
Includes a boss fight.
It’s a relatively casual defense map.

This is a port of a map I created about 7–8 years ago, brought over for the purpose of studying Hammer 2.
Some parts have been modified.
I have confirmed that it works under the CS2fixes environment.
The map was tested on Lupercalia. Thank you for the support!
If you encounter any bugs or have suggestions, please feel free to contact me.

 

・Some visual adjustments (due to difficulties fixing vis issues, certain terrain and other elements have been altered — sorry about that)

・Adjusted the boss’s attacks and the time until enrage

・Added a post-boss defense phase that triggers if certain conditions are met

In creating this port, I received advice from various friends and referred to the S2ZE documentation — thank you very much!
